# Mithran Integrated Solutions

> Mithran Integrated Solutions runs solar and land, business consulting, raw-material transport and industrial scrap recovery as one chain instead of four separate vendors. Based in Madurai, Tamil Nadu. One accountable partner for industrial solar and land, business consulting, bulk raw-material transport and industrial scrap recovery.

## Services

- [Solar & Land](https://www.mithranintegratedsolutions.in/solar-land/): Industrial solar site scoping, system sizing and solar framing, plus buying and selling solar-ready and agricultural land. Includes: Industrial solar, Solar framing, Land buying & selling.
- [Business Consulting](https://www.mithranintegratedsolutions.in/business-consulting/): Growth strategy, financial planning and advisory work for owners who need a second set of eyes on the balance sheet and the roadmap. Includes: Strategic growth, Financial planning, Advisory workflows.
- [Raw Materials Transport](https://www.mithranintegratedsolutions.in/transport/): Fleet and logistics coordination for bulk raw-material freight, with route planning that cuts fuel spend and turnaround time. Includes: Logistics & fleet, Route optimisation, Raw material freight.
- [Industry Scrap](https://www.mithranintegratedsolutions.in/scrap/): Metal sorting and scrap recovery for sustainable waste handling — industrial byproduct routed back into working capital. Includes: Metal sorting, Scrap recovery, Recycling pipelines, Waste handling.

## Frequently asked questions

### What does Mithran Integrated Solutions do?
Mithran Integrated Solutions runs four connected lines of work: industrial solar and land, business consulting, raw-material transport, and industrial scrap recovery. They are offered as one chain so that a project does not lose time or money at the handovers between separate vendors.

### Where is Mithran Integrated Solutions based?
Mithran Integrated Solutions is based in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India.

### Can I hire you for only one of the four services?
Yes. Each link stands on its own — you can take solar and land, consulting, transport or scrap recovery separately, or the whole chain. We will say honestly which parts we should run and which you already have covered.

### What kind of solar work do you do?
Industrial solar: site scoping, system sizing, solar framing and the paperwork behind it. We also source and broker the land itself, both solar-ready and agricultural parcels.

### Do you buy and sell land?
Yes. We source and broker land parcels, including solar-ready sites and agricultural land, as part of the solar and land vertical.

### What do you transport?
Bulk raw materials. We handle fleet and logistics coordination for raw-material freight, including route planning aimed at cutting fuel spend and turnaround time.

### Do you buy industrial scrap?
We handle metal sorting and scrap recovery, routing industrial byproduct back into working capital through recycling pipelines and sustainable waste handling.
